rules.title: Berkeley rent control coverage (pre-1980 multifamily units)
rules.requirement: Most units in Berkeley multifamily buildings built before 1980 (Certificate of Occupancy on or before June 1980) are fully covered by Berkeley rent control, so their rent increases are limited under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance. Units built after June 1980, most condominiums, and single-family homes with tenancies that began on or after January 1, 1996 are not rent controlled.
rules.key_value: Rent control applies to units with Certificate of Occupancy on or before June 1980
rules.coverage_conditions: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses (five or more rooms rented individually with separate leases). Includes units with Section 8 vouchers, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME, City Housing Trust Fund and similar subsidies. Excludes new construction (Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980), most condominiums, single-family homes with tenancies starting on or after 1/1/1996, and certain HUD-subsidized units.
rules.exemptions: New construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with tenancy beginning on or after Jan 1, 1996; most condominiums; Section 202/811 units; Rental Supplement/Section 8 LMSA/project-based Section 8 units in projects with HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgages; Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on 12/31/1979 and now); owner shares kitchen or bath; tenancies after Nov 7, 2018 on owner-occupied ADU properties; dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance (Berkeley Mun. Code Ch. 13.76)
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

exemption_tests.description: New construction: units built and receiving Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 are not rent controlled (partially covered).
Most condominiums are not rent controlled.
Single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996 is not rent controlled.
Units with Section 202 or Section 811 subsidies, or Rental Supplement/Section 8 LMSA/project-based Section 8 subsidies in a project with a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage, are not rent controlled.
Golden Duplex: duplex owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied is fully exempt.
Unit where owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and owner lived on property when tenancy started is fully exempt.
Tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied are fully exempt.

rules.conflict_note: State Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act limits local rent control (new construction, single-family homes and condos with post-1995 tenancies), which is reflected in these exemptions. Where Berkeley rent control covers a unit it governs instead of the statewide cap (Civ. Code § 1947.12); units outside local rent control may still be subject to the state cap. Document gives the cutoff as 'built before 1980' and 'Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980'; the exact June 1980 boundary date is inferred.

rules.title: Berkeley just cause for eviction coverage
rules.requirement: Most Berkeley rental units, including new construction, condominiums, and single-family homes, are covered by Berkeley's just cause eviction protections, so the landlord needs a just cause allowed by the ordinance to evict. Fully exempt units (Golden Duplex, shared kitchen/bath with owner, certain owner-occupied ADU properties) are not covered.
rules.key_value: Just cause applies to fully and partially covered units, including post-1980 new construction
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully and partially covered units: pre-1980 multifamily units, new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes regardless of tenancy start, most condominiums, rooming houses, and listed subsidized units (including Section 202/811 and HUD-mortgage project-based Section 8).
rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on 12/31/1979 and now); owner shares kitchen or bath and lived on property at tenancy start; tenancies after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance (Berkeley Mun. Code Ch. 13.76)

Tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied are exempt.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest coverage
rules.requirement: Tenants in fully and partially covered Berkeley rental units are entitled to interest on their security deposits under the Berkeley ordinance. Fully exempt units are not covered.
rules.key_value: Security deposit interest required for covered units
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully and partially covered units, including pre-1980 multifamily, new construction, single-family homes, most condominiums, rooming houses, and listed subsidized units.
rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex; owner shares kitchen or bath; tenancies after Nov 7, 2018 on owner-occupied ADU properties; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

notes: The document is a coverage table from the Berkeley Rent Board. It does not give the substance of each rule: no allowable increase amount, no list of just causes, no interest rate, and no effective dates. The citation 'Berkeley Mun. Code Ch. 13.76' is not printed in the document. It comes from the ordinance name the document gives ('Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance'). The rent control cutoff is written two ways: 'built before 1980' and 'Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980' (partially covered). I set built_on_or_before to 1980-06-30. Registration is also shown in the table but is outside the six categories. The dormitory exemption was skipped under the instructions. The state Costa-Hawkins limits are flagged in the rent control record.
